Zero-dep skil"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"l + host-only bundle."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# ⚡ dsh-agent-conductor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Your AI fleet, ready when you are.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Delegate tasks from DeepSeek Harness to 11 external agent CLIs, follow their progress in the Big Fat"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" Fish Commander, and bring results back to your conversation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**大肥鱼指挥官 · Big Fat Fish Commander**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A small fleet for big tasks."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**English** · **简体中文**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 🐟 Meet your command room"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"From the **指挥官** entry in the DSH sidebar, see your crew, check whether each CLI is available, and f"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ollow dispatches as they happen. Select **Connect** for an installation or sign-in guidance draft, o"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"r **Dispatch** to start with an editable task example. The draft is never sent automatically."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Meet the crew"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The captain and crew are AI-generated interpretations made for this project; they are not official c"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"haracters of the CLI vendors. Artwork is shown here as a visual collection; the panel assigns each p"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ortrait to its agent."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> **Availability is not authentication.** Finding a CLI executable does not confirm that it is signe"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"d in or ready to run. The panel labels sign-in as unverified."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is a great reasoning engine — but sometimes the job is better done by *another* cod"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ing agent: a Codex translation, a Claude Code investigation, a Cursor refactor. This plugin lets you"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"r DSH agent **recognize when to delegate** (by skill-description matching), **dispatch a self-contai"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ned task** to one of 11 external agent CLIs in headless mode, and **bring the stdout result back as "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"the answer** — while the **大肥鱼指挥官** panel shows the fleet's live status."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> Inspired by Multica — the "agent squad" idea as a zero-install DSH skill."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 🎯 When to use Conductor"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Independent second opinion:** ask Codex, Claude Code, or Gemini to review the same design and co"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"mpare their reasoning.
- **Legacy-code investigation:** have one agent trace a call chain while anot"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"her checks risks, regressions, and migration options.
- **Cross-model implementation:** use an agent"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" whose toolchain or model fits the job, then bring its result back to DSH."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## ✨ What you get"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Capability | What it does | Cost |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| 🧠 Auto-triggered dispatch | Say "have Codex translate this README" — the model matches the skill, "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"runs the dispatch script, and answers from the result | Free (uses the target CLI's quota) |
| 🔧 `co"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"nductor_dispatch` tool (optional bundle) | The same registry as a first-class DSH tool, installed in"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"to a profile with one command | Free |
| 🐟 大肥鱼指挥官 panel (bundle) | Sidebar tab just above 更多: 11 chi"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"bi crew cards with live status, elapsed time and output tail, a ship log, per-run detail and a 终止 bu"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"tton, and adjustable history retention | Free |
| 🩺 `doctor` self-check | `python3 dispatch.py docto"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"r` probes which CLIs are installed (resolves PATH + tries `--version`) before you dispatch | Free |
"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"| 👀 Dry-run preview | Preview the target, working directory, argv, and shell-equivalent command with"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"out starting an external agent | Free |
| 👥 11 agent CLIs | Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, "},{"id":"p19s10","text":"Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok | Their login quotas |
| 🔒 Privacy | Task text "},{"id":"p19s11","text":"goes only to the CLI's own provider; keys stay local | — |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## 🧭 Why a Skill (and not just a plugin)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| | profile plugin / bundle | dynamic plugin | **Skill (this repo)** |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Install | write profile + restart | define in-session | **copy a folder** |
| Trigger | manual | m"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"odel calls a tool | **description matching, model auto-recognizes** |
| Risk | touches the host | se"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ssion-scoped, gone on restart | read-only script, host-agnostic |
| Result | tool result | tool resu"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"lt | **stdout directly becomes the answer** |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"One `SKILL.md` + a zero-dependency `dispatch.py` (Python stdlib only)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## ⚡ Quick start (Skill)"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Copy `skills/conductor/` to any skill root (project-level `.dsh/skills/` or global `~/.dsh/skills/`)"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"opy `skills/conductor/` to any skill root (project-level `.dsh/skills/` or global `~/.dsh/skills/`):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"No restart needed — from the next message on, just say:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- "派 codex 把这份 README 翻译成繁体中文" (have Codex translate this README)
- "让 Claude Code 查一下这个报错的成因" (ask "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"Claude Code to investigate this error)
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 🧭 Agent capability matrix"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Task | First choices | Why |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Architecture review / second opinion | Codex, Claude Code, Gemini | Different reasoning styles are"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" useful for catching design blind spots |
| Legacy-code call-chain investigation | Claude Code, Code"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"x, Copilot | Good for tracing repository-local dependencies and attaching evidence |
| GitHub-centri"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"c issue or Actions analysis | Copilot, Codex | Natural fit for repositories, pull requests, and CI d"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"iagnostics |
| Editor-coupled refactor | Cursor, Codex | Useful when the workflow is tightly connect"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"ed to an existing project tree |
| Chinese localization / Chinese docs | TraeCode, Qwen, Kimi, Codex"},{"id":"p31s7","text":" | Strong Chinese-language options; keep terminology consistent in the task |
| Fast alternative imp"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"lementation | OpenCode, Qwen, Kimi | Useful for bounded spikes where a separate login/toolchain is a"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"n | OpenCode, Qwen, Kimi | Useful for bounded spikes where a separate login/toolchain is available |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The matrix is a routing starting point, not a hard rule. Prefer an installed, logged-in CLI that has"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" access to the correct workspace."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## 🔑 Keys & privacy"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Keys are never stored in this repo. The skill script reads env vars, then `~/.dsh/secrets/media-to"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ols.env` (same convention as dsh-media-skills).
- The panel is local-only: completed-run summaries a"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"nd retention settings are saved in `~/.dsh/conductor-crew.json`; command arguments and output tails "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"remain in memory. Nothing is uploaded.
- Task text is sent to the target CLI's provider — never put "},{"id":"p34s5","text":"secrets or internal data into a task.
- Results belong to the target CLI's terms of service; mark de"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"liverables as "done by <agent name>"."}],"truncated":true}
